commands.name: ReviewWfmActivityRelationship
input: seed_tasks: unique canonical task_id/task_revision pairs for 2..1000 WFM Tasks, canonical-sorted by task_id
review_fingerprint: exact lowercase sha256 from WfmActivityRelationshipReviewPreview
reason_category: nonempty one-line UTF-8 text 1..128 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF
steps: pure-preflight require 2..1000 unique canonical UUIDv4 seed task identities, positive integer Task revisions, canonical task_id ordering, one closed decision, exact lowercase sha256 review_fingerprint and bounded reason_category

inside one writer UnitOfWork load every seed Task and require task_kind=wfm plus a distinct canonical TK identity; missing Task/WFM identity returns TASK_NOT_FOUND and any Task revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE before receipt/domain mutation

after the exact seed Task revision precheck, recompute SOMA_WFM_ACTIVITY_RELATIONSHIP_REVIEW_V1 from current authority using the same algorithm as WfmActivityRelationshipReviewPreview and exact-compare the supplied review_fingerprint; any change in WFM identity, source projection, current operational plan, local execution/outcome, retry adjacency, current lineage membership/revision/last decision or complete touched-lineage closure returns TASK_ACTIVITY_REVIEW_STALE before receipt/domain mutation; seed Task revision drift already surfaced by the preceding guard remains TASK_STALE and does not fall through to the fingerprint error

for retry_lineage require exactly two seed Tasks and one existing immutable direct task_retry_relations edge between them in either predecessor/successor direction; this command never creates, redirects or deletes a retry edge

derive the complete affected lineage closure before mutation: every Task currently belonging to a lineage touched by any seed Task is included in the preview/fingerprint so a reviewed merge/split cannot silently change an unreviewed third Task's same-activity relationship; the 1000-seed request bound never caps this authoritative closure

if the requested decision is already the exact accepted current classification for the reviewed seed/closure under the same current authority, return semantic NO_CHANGE after exact freshness; Foundation still persists the command receipt and immutable replay-result snapshot but no lineage event, Task/lineage revision or audit event is created
insert one outer receipt for a material review

distinct_activity assigns each affected Task a fresh opaque singleton activity_lineage_id; append one lineage event per affected Task with reason_code=distinct_activity and prior/new lineage identities, then create/advance each current lineage projection

same_activity assigns the complete affected set to one shared opaque activity lineage; when the complete set already shares one lineage but its last accepted decision differs, preserve that lineage identity and append decision events; otherwise allocate one new shared lineage, append events and create/advance current projections
retry_lineage assigns/reuses one shared lineage exactly as same_activity but records reason_code=retry_lineage and remains bound to the exact immutable retry edge captured by the review fingerprint

unresolved_source_error assigns/reuses one shared lineage exactly as same_activity and records reason_code=unresolved_source_error so unresolved same-activity overlap remains conservatively visible rather than being treated as distinct; it never collapses Task/TK identities or mutates provider source evidence

for every affected Task whose accepted classification materially changes, increment tasks.revision exactly once and task_activity_lineage_current.revision exactly once (or create current revision 1), append one immutable task_activity_lineage_events row and emit one task.activity_relationship_reviewed.v1 audit event using the same command receipt

derive competing-attempt consequence from the resulting shared lineage plus current activity-interval/local-lifecycle evidence; accepting same_activity, retry_lineage or unresolved_source_error is allowed to commit even when it yields a competing-attempt condition, because WFM_COMPETING_ATTEMPT is a downstream blocking classification rather than a rollback error for this review command
commit atomically; any failure after the first lineage/event/current/Task/audit write rolls back every participant change and the one receipt
rules: activity lineage is reviewed SOMA operational classification only; same RFC, Task Name, Summary, source status or overlap never infers lineage by itself
Task identity and canonical TK identity are immutable and are never merged by any decision

task_activity_lineage_events.reason_code stores the closed accepted decision token for current classification authority; operator rationale remains the bounded audit reason_category and never substitutes for the decision token

current accepted decision for a Task is the reason_code of task_activity_lineage_current.last_event_id; current projection must resolve to a same-Task event whose new_lineage_id equals the projection lineage
distinct_activity never deletes current projection/history; it moves affected Tasks to fresh singleton lineages so prior shared classifications remain immutable evidence
unresolved_source_error is conservative shared-lineage authority, not evidence that the Tasks are definitively one provider activity
retry_lineage consumes an existing retry edge; LinkWfmRetryAttempt is the only owner that may create a WFM retry edge

provider source plan and accepted SOMA operational plan remain separate authorities. Conflict evaluation may use the current operational interval when present and otherwise the accepted source interval only as explicitly tagged conflict evidence; source fallback never becomes Task scheduling, Objective grouping or execution authority
local activity remains active until accepted local execution/outcome authority makes the Task terminal; provider Complete/Plan Cancel alone never fabricates local termination
semantic NO_CHANGE has exact replay evidence but no new domain/audit history
material multi-Task review uses WfmActivityRelationshipReviewResultV1 rather than single-Task TaskMutationResultV1

review_fingerprint.name: SOMA_WFM_ACTIVITY_RELATIONSHIP_REVIEW_V1
review_fingerprint.encoding: canonical versioned JSON hashed with SHA-256 lowercase hex
inputs: canonical sorted seed Task ids and exact tasks.revision values
for each seed/affected Task: immutable TK identity and current owning-RFC assignment identity/revision
current WFM source projection revision or exact absence 0, provider lifecycle class and source-plan interval/null
current Task operational-plan projection revision or exact absence 0 plus exact current plan revision id/interval/null
current local execution projection revision or exact absence 0 plus derived execution state
current Task outcome projection revision or exact absence 0 plus accepted outcome/null
immutable direct retry predecessor/successor relation ids for the reviewed scope
current activity-lineage projection revision or exact absence 0, current lineage id/null, last lineage event id/null and last accepted decision/null
complete deterministic task_id-sorted membership of every current lineage touched by a seed Task
review_fingerprint.rule: Any material change to one fingerprint input invalidates the preview. The command first checks explicit seed Task revisions and returns TASK_STALE for that base-revision drift; other current-authority fingerprint drift returns TASK_ACTIVITY_REVIEW_STALE. Unrelated descriptive metadata and RFC/source fields not listed here do not stale the review.
